package.name: mowgli_openmower_bridge
package.description: Hardware bridge for stock OpenMower (v1 mainboard) electronics: speaks the OpenMower LowLevel (Pico) COBS protocol and the xESC 2040 / xESC mini (VESC) motor-controller protocols, and publishes the exact hardware_bridge ROS2 contract MowgliNext expects (status, emergency, power, battery, IMU, wheel odometry, blade and e-stop services). Runs as its own sidecar container next to mowgli-ros2 when HARDWARE_BACKEND=openmower; the OpenMower firmware is left untouched.
